resources.string: Live audio is processed on your phone. Sound profiles and preferences are stored locally. Microphone audio is not saved. You choose whether to share your hearing-check results. EarCast does not upload your audio or sound profiles. All features are free, with no purchases or account required. This optional development build requests Google test ads on Home. Google may process device and network metadata; microphone audio and hearing profiles are never included in ad requests. See https://policies.google.com/privacy.

Live audio is processed on your phone. Sound profiles and preferences are stored locally. Microphone audio is not saved. You choose whether to share your hearing-check results. EarCast does not upload your audio or sound profiles. All features are free, with no purchases or account required. This optional development build requests Google test ads on Home. Google may process device and network metadata; microphone audio and hearing profiles are never included in ad requests. See https://policies.google.com/privacy.

EarCast processes microphone audio on your phone to play amplified sound to your headset. Assist can continue while the screen is off or you use other apps, with an ongoing notification. Stop assist to stop microphone access. Live audio is discarded after processing and is not saved.

Sound profiles, hearing-check results and settings remain in app-private storage. EarCast excludes its data from Android cloud backup and device transfer.

Hearing-check results leave the app only when you choose to share them. The receiving app then handles that copy under its own policies. EarCast has no account, backend or analytics and does not upload your hearing data.

All features are free. This development build includes Google AdMob test banners.

Recordings saved by older versions remain in private storage until you clear app storage or uninstall. Clear app storage in Android Settings or uninstall EarCast to remove its local data. Copies you exported are not removed by this. Reinstalling does not restore local profiles.

For privacy questions, use the support contact in the Play store listing or the published policy below. This optional development build requests Google test ads on Home. Google may process device and network metadata; microphone audio and hearing profiles are never included in ad requests. See https://policies.google.com/privacy.
